scope: active map-scan event run/server identity admission

recoveredResult.activeGate: events are admitted only while current scan state isReading=true
recoveredResult.scanRunId: if event scanRunId is present and nonempty, it must byte-match the active scanRunId; missing/empty is tolerated
recoveredResult.serverId: if event serverId is positive, it must equal the active scan-state serverId; zero/missing is tolerated
recoveredResult.eventPath: map.scan.progress, map.scan.complete and map.scan.error pass this helper before scan-event processing

limits: this finding does not claim every event carries scanRunId or serverId
missing identity fields are tolerated by the recovered helper rather than synthesized
game-side event generation and delivery ordering remain unrecovered
